verifyNote: Shops, keepers and prices are our own (PHB prices for mundane gear; magic item prices from the XGtE ranges). Temple service prices follow the DMG's spellcasting-services guidance as remembered [inferred].

shops.name: Brannoc's stores
shops.blurb: “Rope, oil, torches, a flask of something that burns. Swords and mail you'll want from Hulda at the forge.”

shops.name: Stonemantle Forge
shops.blurb: “Steel's honest. People aren't. Tell me what you swing and I'll tell you what you need.”

shops.name: Quillon's Curios
shops.blurb: “Wands, pearls, a ring or two. Most of it wants a spellcaster's touch; the rest just wants paying for.”

shops.name: The Dawn Shrine
shops.blurb: “The Morninglord turns no one away. The roof, however, needs mending, so the shrine does ask a gift.”

services.name: Healing prayers
services.summary: Every wounded hero is healed to full (10 gp each). No need to rest.

services.name: Restoration
services.summary: Lifts all exhaustion from one hero (a lesser blessing than the spell, but enough).

services.name: Raise the dead
services.summary: Brings a fallen hero back to life with 1 hit point (the gift pays for the diamond).

shops.name: Odo's wagon
shops.blurb: “Fresh from Daggerford! Well. Fresh-ish. Two to a customer, my friends; I've other towns to rob. Sell to. Sell to.”

shops.name: Nib's sack
shops.blurb: “Not stolen! Found. Found from people. One thing each, big-folk, Nib has to run soon.”

shops.name: Ssessk's shell-trade
shops.blurb: “Drowned people drop things. Ssessk picks them up. You give coin, you take one. Then you go.”

shops.name: Brokk's forge-cache
shops.blurb: “My clan threw me out for selling. So I sell. Pick one, and don't tell them where you got it.”
